import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULUS = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total = scanner.nextInt();
        int factor = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] k_values = new int[total];
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            k_values[i] = (factor * i) % total;
        }

        if (factor == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total, total - 1, MODULUS));
            return;
        }
        if (factor == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total, total, MODULUS));
            return;
        }

        int[] visited_nodes = new int[total];
        int[] cycle_sizes = new int[total + 1]; // size index up to total
        long result_value = 1;

        for (int start_node = 0; start_node < total; start_node++) {
            if (visited_nodes[start_node] != 0) {
                continue;
            }
            int length = 1;
            int node = start_node;
            visited_nodes[node] = 1;
            while (visited_nodes[k_values[node]] == 0) {
                node = k_values[node];
                visited_nodes[node] = 1;
                length++;
            }
            cycle_sizes[length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 2; size < total; size++) {
            if (cycle_sizes[size] != 0) {
                long total_size = size * cycle_sizes[size] + 1;
                result_value = (result_value * powMod(total_size, cycle_sizes[size], MODULUS)) % MODULUS;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(result_value);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long power = base % mod;
        long exponent = exp;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * power) % mod;
            }
            power = (power * power) % mod;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
